payload.name: Gong
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gong brings deep revenue insights into your ChatGPT workflows, helping teams ask questions, generate briefs, and surface risks, objections, next steps, and stakeholder context from Gong AI OS data.
payload.longDescription: Gong 将深入的营收洞察融入 ChatGPT 工作流程，帮助团队根据 Gong AI OS 数据提出问题、生成简报，并发现风险、异议、后续步骤和利益相关方背景。

payload.name: Revise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revise connects ChatGPT and other AI agents to a fully featured word processor. Create, import, search, and edit real documents; collaborate across hundreds of pages; review AI edits as tracked changes; manage layouts, footnotes, and collaborators; and export to DOCX, PDF, Markdown, HTML, or plain text.

payload.name: Tweek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tweek is a minimal weekly planner and to-do app. Connect it to view and manage your Tweek calendars, weekly tasks and someday-lists directly from ChatGPT — list what's on your week, create, update, complete and delete tasks in natural language, break a task into subtasks, and act on many tasks at once with bulk tools. Every action is scoped to your own account over OAuth 2.1; the assistant acts as you and never sees other users' data. Best for quick, natural-language task capture and weekly review.

payload.name: Spkr - Chat to Podcast Episode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The ChatGPT Spkr app allows subscribers to convert any ChatGPT answer to a podcast episode for later listening. 

The podcast episodes can be listened to in the Spkr mobile app or any podcast player.

Examples:
“Create a 10-minute podcast episode explaining what the world might look like in 2035.”
“Create a podcast episode explaining how to build better habits using behavioral science.”
“Explain black holes like I’m an intelligent non-scientist.”
“Tell the story of how the internet was invented and the key people behind it.”

Spkr is an app that allows users to convert articles, documents, emails, and ChatGPT responses to personalize podcasts for later listening.

payload.name: Autocalls AI
payload.description: 构建并运行 AI 电话智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Autocalls 让你构建并运行 AI 电话智能体——现在，你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中完成，无需切换到仪表板。描述你的需求，助手就会接手处理。

通过聊天创建和完善助手：为呼入智能体（接听电话、接受预约、筛选潜在客户）和呼出智能体（跟进、提醒、筛选潜在客户）设置提示词、声音、语言、模型和通话行为。为它们附加可在通话中实时调用你的 API 的工具，以及让回答以你自己的文档为依据的知识库，赋予它们实际能力。

大规模开展呼出任务：创建活动，添加潜在客户，并随时启动、暂停或恢复。然后完成闭环——列出通话，打开任意一条查看完整转写和通话后评估，更新助手或其工具以修正问题，全都在同一段对话中完成。

还可以管理账号的其他内容：知识库与文档、电话号码和 SIP 中继、WhatsApp 发件方与模板、对话、文件夹、标签和 API 密钥。

控制权始终在你手中。每个工具仅操作你自己的账号，读取和写入是不同的操作，任何消耗余额或删除数据的操作都会明确标注，已存储的密钥会被遮蔽。只需通过安全登录连接一次——无需将 API 密钥粘贴到聊天中。

payload.name: Fibery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, OpenAI can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.

1. Read & query
Explore your workspace structure (spaces, databases, fields), query any database with filtering, sorting, and sub-queries, run full-text search across entities, documents, and comments, inspect activity history (who changed what, and when), and pull data from saved views with their filters applied.

2. Create & update
Create, update, and delete entities, move them through workflow states, assign people and link related records, write documents, add comments, and attach files.

3. Modify structure
Create spaces and databases, add fields of any type available in Fibery (including formulas), and build views — boards, timelines, calendars, gantt charts, forms, and more.
payload.longDescription:
将 Fibery MCP 连接到工作区后，OpenAI 几乎可以执行你在 Fibery 中能做的任何操作——读取和写入数据，或调整工作区结构。

1. 读取和查询
探索工作区结构（空间、数据库、字段），通过筛选、排序和子查询来查询任意数据库；对实体、文档和评论进行全文搜索；查看活动历史（谁在何时更改了什么）；并读取应用了筛选条件的已保存视图数据。

2. 创建和更新
创建、更新和删除实体，在工作流状态间移动实体，分配人员并关联记录，撰写文档、添加评论和附加文件。

3. 修改结构
创建空间和数据库，添加 Fibery 支持的任意类型字段（包括公式），并构建看板、时间线、日历、甘特图和表单等视图。

payload.name: BluTranslate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BluTranslate lets you translate uploaded documents in ChatGPT through an interactive Bluente widget. Upload a file, choose target language and translation options, start the translation task, track progress, and download the translated result. The app handles document translation workflows and does not generate ad-hoc translation text in chat.
payload.longDescription: BluTranslate 让你通过交互式 Bluente 小组件，在 ChatGPT 中翻译上传的文档。上传文件、选择目标语言和翻译选项、启动翻译任务、追踪进度，并下载翻译结果。本应用处理文档翻译工作流程，不会在聊天中生成即时翻译文本。

payload.name: Sociality.io for social media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your Sociality.io workspace to analyze social media performance, competitor activity, and post-level results in one conversation. Ask ChatGPT to review account metrics, compare tracked competitors, summarize content performance, and find patterns across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

Use Sociality MCP to turn your social media data into practical reporting, benchmarking, and competitive research workflows. It helps marketers, agencies, and social media teams understand what changed, what performed well, and where to focus next.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Sociality.io 工作区，在一次对话中分析社交媒体表现、竞争对手动态和帖子级结果。让 ChatGPT 查看账户指标、比较已追踪的竞争对手、总结内容表现，并查找 Facebook、Instagram、X、LinkedIn、YouTube 和 TikTok 上的规律。

使用 Sociality MCP，将社交媒体数据转化为实用的报告、基准比较和竞争研究工作流。它能帮助营销人员、代理机构和社交媒体团队了解发生了哪些变化、哪些内容表现良好，以及接下来应关注什么。

payload.name: Mapify
payload.description: 将任意内容转为思维导图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mapify turns text, documents, webpages, YouTube links, audio, video, images, and research prompts into interactive mind maps. Users can render Markdown directly or start private Mapify tasks that process source material, handle follow-up clarification, and return zoomable hierarchies for exploring concepts, meeting notes, media, and research findings.
payload.longDescription: Mapify 可将文本、文档、网页、YouTube 链接、音频、视频、图像和研究提示转化为交互式思维导图。用户可以直接渲染 Markdown，也可以启动私密 Mapify 任务来处理源材料、进行后续澄清，并返回可缩放的层级结构，以探索概念、会议记录、媒体和研究发现。

payload.name: TasksBoard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TasksBoard is a simple, board-style to-do app that keeps all your daily tasks in one place. Create multiple lists side by side - like Work, Personal, Groceries, or any project you're juggling - and see everything at a glance on a clean, distraction-free board.

Add tasks in seconds, break them down with subtasks, set due dates, and add notes for the details you don't want to forget. Drag and drop to reorder or move tasks between lists as your priorities shift. Check things off and enjoy watching your board clear.

Your tasks stay in sync across all your devices, so your list is always up to date whether you're at your desk or on the go. You can also share lists with family, roommates, or teammates to plan and get things done together in real time.

Whether you're organizing your workday, planning a trip, or managing a household, TasksBoard gives you a focused, visual way to stay on top of everything that matters.

payload.name: 2+2 Calculator
payload.description: 数学与科学计算、百分比及分数……
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A simple calculator for performing addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, right in ChatGPT!


- Supports Plain and Scientific mode
- Degrees and Radians
- Powers, roots, exponential, logs
- Trig supported
payload.longDescription:
简单的计算器，让你直接在 ChatGPT 中进行加、减、乘、除运算！

- 支持普通模式和科学模式
- 角度和弧度
- 幂、根、指数和对数
- 支持三角函数

payload.name: SurveyMonkey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover insights directly in ChatGPT.  Search your surveys, review results, generate summaries, and explore trends without switching tools. Easily turn feedback into clear next steps for teams, customers, employees, and more.

payload.name: Lnk.Bio
payload.description: 添加、编辑并美化你的 Lnk.
payload.summaryOriginal: Add, edit, and style your Lnk.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your entire Lnk.Bio profile directly from Claude. Add, edit, schedule, and reorder links. Create pages, add content blocks like titles, bios, and buttons. Set up social icons for Instagram, TikTok, and more. Browse and apply themes, customize colors and fonts, or set wallpapers. Make Lnk.Bio a native part of your AI workflow, so you can build and update your link-in-bio page faster, through conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 Claude 管理完整的 Lnk.Bio 个人资料。添加、编辑、安排发布时间并重新排序链接；创建页面，添加标题、简介和按钮等内容区块；设置 Instagram、TikTok 等社交平台图标。浏览并应用主题，自定义颜色和字体，或设置壁纸。将 Lnk.Bio 融入 AI 工作流程，通过对话更快地创建和更新个人简介链接页面。

payload.name: Career Adapter
payload.description: 根据任何职位定制简历
payload.summaryOriginal: Tailor your resume to any job
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this when the user wants to adapt, tailor, customize, rewrite, polish, or optimize their resume for a specific job posting, or wants help applying to a role. Produces a downloadable, professionally-formatted PDF resume saved to the user's Career Adapter account, the content rewritten to match the posting's requirements.
payload.longDescription: 当用户希望针对特定职位招聘信息调整、定制、改写、润色或优化简历，或希望获得应聘某个职位的帮助时使用。生成一份可下载、格式专业的 PDF 简历，将内容改写为符合招聘信息要求的版本，并保存到用户的 Career Adapter 账户。

payload.name: AnyPDF - Your PDF Converter
payload.description: 一句提示即可转换 PDF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage and transform your documents seamlessly right inside ChatGPT. This all-in-one PDF utility allows you to compress, convert, merge, and edit your files instantly with professional precision.
Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.

How to Use
1. Choose your file and tell us what you want to do. (e.g., "@AnyPDF - Your PDF Converter Compress this file") 
2. Allow the upload: ChatGPT will ask for your permission to upload. Press "Upload Document".

Thats all!

Now your file is ready to download

Key features:
- Smart Compression: Choose from three levels—Low, Recommended, or Extreme—to shrink file sizes while maintaining document clarity.
- Universal Converter: Instantly turn Images (JPEG, PNG), Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX) into PDFs or turn your PDFs into JPG.
- Merge Multiple PDFs: Combine two or more PDF documents into a single, organized file in seconds.
- Extract Specific Pages: Extract the pages you need from any PDF to create a new document.
- Rotate & Align: Fix orientation issues by rotating your PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 内顺畅管理和转换文档。这款一体化 PDF 工具可即时压缩、转换、合并和编辑文件，达到专业精度。
适合学生、专业人士，以及任何希望无需打开其他应用就能快速、可靠地处理 PDF 的人。

使用方法
1. 选择文件，并告诉我们你想做什么。（例如：“@AnyPDF - Your PDF Converter 压缩这个文件”）
2. 允许上传：ChatGPT 会请求你的上传许可。点击“Upload Document”。

就这么简单！

现在你的文件可以下载了

主要功能：
- 智能压缩：从低、推荐或极限三档中选择，在保持文档清晰度的同时缩小文件大小。
- 通用转换器：即时将图片（JPEG、PNG）、Word（DOCX）、Excel（XLSX）、PowerPoint（PPTX）转换为 PDF，或将 PDF 转为 JPG。
- 合并多个 PDF：几秒内将两个或更多 PDF 文档合并为一个有序文件。
- 提取指定页面：从任何 PDF 中提取所需页面，创建新文档。
- 旋转与对齐：将 PDF 页面旋转 90、180 或 270 度，修正方向问题。

payload.name: Cambiante: Content Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cambiante LinkedIn Content Manager helps tenant workspaces create LinkedIn drafts, attach generated images, review content, approve or reject posts, schedule posts, explicitly publish approved content, and inspect audit logs and analytics through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Cambiante LinkedIn Content Manager 帮助租户工作空间创建 LinkedIn 草稿、附加生成的图片、审阅内容、批准或拒绝帖子、安排帖子发布、明确发布已批准的内容，并通过 ChatGPT 查看审计日志和分析数据。

payload.name: Awesome Slides
payload.description: 带视频与配音的幻灯片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place.
Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover. 

Key Features
- Multi-source input: Create presentations from a simple topic, pasted text, an uploaded PDF, or a web URL.
- Automated slide design: The AI builds layouts, selects relevant images, and creates diagrams automatically.
- Conversational editing: Refine slides using natural commands to change the tone, shorten text, or add new sections.
- Precision control: Edit any text manually or ask the AI to revise it. Use your own images or generate new AI visuals.
- Export and share: Download a fully editable .pptx file or export your presentation as a video with embedded narration.

How to Use
1. Connect the Awesome Slides app
2. Type "@" and choose the AI Slides app, or type "AI Slides", then enter your prompt

Examples:
- Awesome Slides create a presentation about the history of AI
- Awesome Slides turn this PDF into a 10-slide deck
- Awesome Slides help me make a presentation for my Q3 marketing strategy
payload.longDescription:
一站式 AI 幻灯片应用：在同一个地方创建、编辑幻灯片，并将其导出为带配音的视频。
快速将任意主题、文本、PDF 或 URL 转换为专业设计的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。借助 AI 内容生成，你可以通过对话编辑每个细节，并将作品导出为可编辑的 PPTX 或带配音的视频。

主要功能
- 多来源输入：根据简单主题、粘贴的文本、上传的 PDF 或网页 URL 创建演示文稿。
- 自动幻灯片设计：AI 自动构建布局、选择相关图片并创建图表。
- 对话式编辑：使用自然语言命令调整幻灯片语气、缩短文本或添加新章节。
- 精确控制：手动编辑任何文字，或让 AI 修改。使用自己的图片，或生成新的 AI 视觉素材。
- 导出与分享：下载完全可编辑的 .pptx 文件，或将演示文稿导出为内嵌旁白的视频。

使用方法
1. 连接 Awesome Slides 应用
2. 输入“@”并选择 AI Slides 应用，或输入“AI Slides”，然后输入提示词

示例：
- Awesome Slides 创建一份关于 AI 历史的演示文稿
- Awesome Slides 将这份 PDF 转为 10 页幻灯片
- Awesome Slides 帮我制作一份 Q3 营销战略演示文稿

payload.name: Fieldy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fieldy lets users retrieve and review their recorded real-world conversations in ChatGPT and Codex. Users can browse recent conversations or a specific date range, open a conversation with its transcript, and inspect exact transcript lines. All available tools are read-only.
payload.longDescription: Fieldy 让用户能够在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中检索并回顾录制的真实对话。用户可以浏览最近的对话或指定日期范围，打开对话及其转录文本，并查看转录中的准确原句。所有可用工具均为只读。

payload.name: Dropbox Dash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dropbox Dash brings knowledge from your favorite workplace apps into one secure place. With the Dash app for ChatGPT, you can use that knowledge directly in your conversations.

Ask a question, and Dash pulls in relevant context from across your connected tools to help ChatGPT give more personalized, accurate answers. This means you get useful, actionable responses without leaving your chat.

Dash respects your existing permissions, so only content you have access to is used—keeping your information secure while making it easier to find and use.
payload.longDescription:
Dropbox Dash 将你常用的工作应用中的知识集中到一个安全的位置。通过适用于 ChatGPT 的 Dash 应用，你可以在对话中直接使用这些知识。

提出问题后，Dash 会从已连接的工具中提取相关背景，帮助 ChatGPT 给出更个性化、更准确的回答。这让你无需离开聊天即可获得实用、可执行的回复。

Dash 遵循你现有的权限，因此只会使用你有权访问的内容，在便于查找和使用信息的同时保护其安全。

payload.name: Voicenotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your voice memos, transcripts and Al meeting notes. Ask questions about past conversations, meetings, resurface forgotten ideas and use your spoken context to draft, plan and get things done right from ChatGPT.

payload.name: AI Wisebase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."

Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."

Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."

Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."
payload.longDescription:
一种与你自己的信息对话的简单方式。

AI Wisebase 是你的个人知识库。它让你能够直接在 ChatGPT 中使用保存的文件和聊天记录，生成基于自身数据的回答。

1. 整理文件和聊天
保存聊天记录：将重要的 ChatGPT 聊天保存为可编辑文档，供日后参考。

上传文件：将个人文件加入知识库，构建你的私人资料库。

便捷访问：在一个简洁列表中查看和访问上传的文件及保存的聊天。

2. 与知识库对话
有依据的回答：提问并获取基于已保存数据的回答，附有源内容引用。这帮助 ChatGPT 撰写报告或总结你关心的主题。

3. 专门的学习工具
视频讲解：将概念转化为易于理解的动画或视频摘要。

知识图谱：生成交互式知识图谱，以可视化方式探索保存的文件和聊天。

学习辅助：将保存的聊天和文件转换成抽认卡或测验，供复习使用。

文档翻译：翻译PDF文件，并并排查看原文与译文。

使用方法：
连接：将 AI Wisebase 关联到你的 ChatGPT 账户。

添加数据：上传文件或直接保存聊天记录。

调用：输入 @AI Wisebase，随后输入你的请求。

示例提示：
保存记录：“@AI Wisebase 将这次讨论保存为文档。”

知识库：“@AI Wisebase 使用我的知识库起草一份报告。”

知识图谱：“@AI Wisebase 为我的文件生成交互式知识图谱。”

视频学习：“@AI Wisebase 创建一个解释此概念的视频。”

测验/抽认卡：“@AI Wisebase 根据我保存的聊天创建抽认卡。”

翻译：“@AI Wisebase 将这个PDF翻译成英语。”

payload.name: Nifty
payload.description: 在聊天中运行你的工作中心
payload.summaryOriginal: Your work hub, run from chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Nifty to build and run your projects straight from chat. Ask your assistant to create a project with phases, tasks, owners, and due dates — it’s live in Nifty in seconds. Search across your workspace, generate status reports, surface stalled tasks, and post updates back, all without leaving the conversation. Nifty stays the single source of truth for your team, so everything your AI creates is organized, shared, and ready to run.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Nifty，直接在聊天中构建和运行项目。让助手创建包含阶段、任务、负责人和截止日期的项目，几秒钟内即可在 Nifty 中生效。在工作区中搜索、生成状态报告、发现停滞任务并发布更新，全程无需离开对话。Nifty 是团队唯一可信的数据来源，因此 AI 创建的内容都会得到整理、共享并可供执行。

payload.name: Jotform Sign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, send, and sign documents directly inside ChatGPT with Jotform Sign. Simply describe what you need to generate a signature-ready document, or upload an existing document to get started. Customize and refine your document through conversation.

Create contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents in minutes. Add recipients, configure signing order, customize fields, and send documents for e-signature—all without switching between tools. Track document status, manage signature requests, and keep every signing workflow moving from one place.

- Generate contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents

- Preview and edit documents inline without leaving the AI workspace
- Refine and revise documents in draft mode before sending them for signature

- Sales proposals and approval requests

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: omi
payload.description: 搜索你的 Omi 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Omi lets ChatGPT retrieve and manage your Omi memories and conversation history. Use it to search past conversations, review conversation details, list remembered facts, and create, edit, or delete private memories in your Omi account
payload.longDescription: Omi 让 ChatGPT 检索和管理你的 Omi 记忆及对话历史。你可以搜索过往对话、查看对话详情、列出已记住的信息，并在自己的 Omi 账户中创建、编辑或删除私人记忆。

payload.name: Simpliciter AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simpliciter AI connects ChatGPT to your Simpliciter legal research account. It helps you discover the legal sources available to you, run semantic research across enabled databases, and retrieve specific statutes, case law, regulations, administrative guidance, or other legal materials by exact reference.

Results include structured citations and source links, so you can ask ChatGPT to compare authorities, summarize legal materials, and draft research notes grounded in the sources returned by Simpliciter.

payload.name: Lawve
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use legal methods and guidance shared by practitioners directly in ChatGPT.

Lawve brings together legal AI skills written by practicing lawyers, in-house counsel, academics, and legal technologists from around the world, covering a wide range of practice areas and jurisdictions. Each skill gives ChatGPT step-by-step instructions for a specific legal task.

 Describe your legal task, and ChatGPT can find a relevant skill on Lawve and apply its author’s methodology directly to your documents or questions.

You can use the Lawve connector to:
    - Challenge an argument: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this legal argument from opposing counsel’s perspective, then identify weaknesses I should address.”
    - Assess an AI system: “Find and apply a skill on Lawve to help classify our recruitment AI tool under the EU AI Act and identify the obligations that follow.”
    - Improve legal writing: “Use a relevant skill on Lawve to make this legal letter clearer and more persuasive, while preserving the facts and my position.”
    - Review against your standards: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this supplier agreement against our negotiation playbook, then flag deviations and suggest changes.”
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接使用执业人士分享的法律方法和指导。

Lawve 汇集了世界各地执业律师、企业法务、学者和法律技术专家编写的法律 AI 技能，涵盖广泛的执业领域和司法辖区。每项技能都会为特定法律任务提供分步说明。

描述你的法律任务后，ChatGPT 可以在 Lawve 上查找相关技能，并将作者的方法直接应用于你的文档或问题。

你可以使用 Lawve 连接器来：
- 挑战论点：“在 Lawve 上找一项技能，从对方律师的角度审查这份法律论点，并指出我应当回应的弱点。”
- 评估 AI 系统：“在 Lawve 上查找并应用一项技能，帮助我们依据《欧盟人工智能法案》对招聘 AI 工具分类，并确定相应义务。”
- 改善法律写作：“使用相关技能，让这封法律函件更清晰、更有说服力，同时保留事实和我的立场。”
- 按标准审查：“查找一项技能，根据我们的谈判手册审查这份供应商协议，然后标记偏差并提出修改建议。”

payload.name: Funnel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Funnel brings all your marketing data, semantics, and business context to ChatGPT in one trusted integration covering Google Ads, Facebook Ads (Meta), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), Shopify, HubSpot and 600+ other platforms. Ask questions like "Compare my spend, CPA, ROAS, and revenue across all my marketing channels in the last 6 months", "How am I pacing towards my budget and revenue target?", or "Which campaigns generated the most HubSpot pipeline?" and get the answers right where you do your work.
payload.longDescription: Funnel 将 Google、Meta、TikTok、LinkedIn、Analytics、Microsoft、Shopify、HubSpot 及 600 多个平台的营销数据、语义和业务背景带入 ChatGPT，可比较渠道支出、CPA、ROAS、收入、预算进度和 HubSpot 管道。

payload.name: Smallpdf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the Smallpdf ChatGPT App, compress your PDFs for submissions, emails, and whatever you need, without reducing quality. Need to convert a PDF to a Word file? Easy; you can even use OCR to make the document editable. You can also convert images, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to PDF, all without leaving ChatGPT. Continue your work on the Smallpdf website to merge, sign, edit, and more.

payload.name: Qarera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Qarera brings your job search into ChatGPT. Search Qarera's job database for roles that fit your experience, save them to a Kanban-style application tracker, and tailor your resume to a specific job with a clear before/after of what changed. Pull up your tracked applications and move them through stages applied, interviewing, offered etc. without leaving the chat. Free to use.

payload.name: AI Passport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Passport is your own memory layer for the AI apps you use. Save a preference, decision, project, or note once and recall it in any connected assistant, so you stop repeating yourself. You stay in control: normal saves arrive as proposals you approve, and each app gets an exact, revocable pass to a category you choose, so no assistant gets blanket access to everything.
payload.longDescription: AI Passport 是你所使用的AI应用的个人记忆层。偏好、决策、项目或笔记只需保存一次，就能在任何已连接助手中调用，无需反复说明。你始终掌控权限：普通保存会作为提案提交给你批准，每个应用只获得对你选择的某一类别的明确、可撤销通行权限，因此任何助手都不会获得对全部内容的笼统访问权。

payload.name: Primitive Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Primitive Email lets users create an agent-ready email address, read and search inbound mail, send new messages, reply in threads, manage domains and webhooks, inspect delivery history, and troubleshoot email routing from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Spinach AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and recall everything from your Spinach meetings, right inside ChatGPT. Pull summaries, action items, and decisions from any past meeting by date, attendee, project, or topic — and find specific moments in transcripts without scrolling through hours of notes.

payload.name: XMemo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: XMemo gives ChatGPT a private, persistent workspace that carries useful context across conversations. It can save, search, recall, read full memory text, explain, update, and organize preferences, decisions, project context, reference notes, TODOs, and personal Ledger records. Interactive TODO Board, Ledger, and Project Workspace views turn remembered context into structured work without leaving ChatGPT. OAuth and server-enforced scopes restrict every operation to the signed-in user's authorized data, while recoverable deletion, restoration, and explicit confirmation for permanent deletion keep users in control.

payload.name: Sunsama
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The only task manager, calendar, and daily planner for modern professionals. Eliminate distractions, find flow, and do more high-impact work without burning out. The digital daily planner that helps you feel calm and stay focused.

payload.name: MoveMate: Gym Workout Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MoveMate connects your training data to ChatGPT. Ask about your workout history, volume, and personal records; track progression on specific lifts; search MoveMate's exercise library (including your own custom exercises); and schedule a planned workout that shows up in your MoveMate app on the date you choose. Reading your stats is free — scheduling a workout requires a connected MoveMate account.
payload.longDescription: MoveMate 将你的训练数据连接到 ChatGPT。询问训练历史、训练量和个人纪录；追踪特定举重项目的进步；搜索 MoveMate 运动库（包括你自定义的运动）；并安排一项计划训练，让它在你指定的日期显示于 MoveMate 应用中。免费查看统计数据；安排训练则需要连接 MoveMate 账户。

payload.name: ConvertAPI
payload.description: 文件转换和 PDF 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ConvertAPI converts, processes, and extracts data from files in over 500 formats - directly in your ChatGPT conversation. Upload a file, describe what you want, and get the result back ready to download.

Convert between PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, HTML, eBooks, and email formats. Turn a PDF into an editable Word doc, a PowerPoint into images, a webpage into PDF, or scanned pages into searchable text.

Edit and combine PDFs: merge multiple files, split by page or bookmark, rotate, delete pages, add watermarks, or repair corrupted documents.

Secure and optimize: compress PDFs by up to 90%, add password protection, redact sensitive information with AI, or convert to PDF/A for archiving.

Extract text, tables, images, form data, and email attachments from your documents.

Generate new DOCX or PDF files from templates and data, compare documents, or bundle files into password-protected ZIP archives.
Powered by the ConvertAPI platform - trusted by thousands of developers and businesses for document automation since 2013.
payload.longDescription:
ConvertAPI 可直接在 ChatGPT 对话中转换、处理并从 500 多种格式的文件中提取数据。上传文件、描述需求，即可获得可下载结果。

在 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、图像、HTML、电子书和邮件格式之间转换。将 PDF 变成可编辑 Word 文档、将 PowerPoint 转为图像、将网页转成 PDF，或将扫描页面转为可搜索文本。

编辑和合并 PDF：合并多个文件、按页面或书签拆分、旋转、删除页面、添加水印或修复损坏文件。

安全与优化：将 PDF 压缩最多 90%，添加密码保护，使用 AI 编辑敏感信息，或转换为 PDF/A 以便归档。

从文档中提取文本、表格、图像、表单数据和邮件附件。

根据模板和数据生成新的 DOCX 或 PDF，比较文档，或将文件打包成受密码保护的 ZIP 压缩包。
由 ConvertAPI 平台提供支持；该平台自 2013 年以来一直受到数千名开发者和企业信赖，用于文档自动化。

payload.name: Wordy- Highlight+Annotate Text
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

payload.name: Dunzo - Task Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dunzo is a conversational task assistant that helps you capture and organize tasks through natural conversation.

What you can do:
• Capture quick tasks: "remind me to call mom" or "buy milk"
• Manage ongoing lists: groceries, packing lists, movies to watch
• Plan projects: break down bigger goals into steps

Just tell ChatGPT what you need to do, and Dunzo tracks it for you. No forms, no apps to switch between – just chat.

Dunzo is an independent product and is not affiliated with any other companies or services.
payload.longDescription:
Dunzo 是一款对话式任务助手，可通过自然对话帮你记录和整理任务。

你可以：
• 快速记录任务：“提醒我给妈妈打电话”或“买牛奶”
• 管理持续更新的清单：杂货、行李打包清单、待看的电影
• 规划项目：将较大的目标分解为若干步骤

只需告诉 ChatGPT 你要做什么，Dunzo 就会为你跟进。无需表单，也无需切换应用——只需聊天。

Dunzo 是独立产品，与任何其他公司或服务均无关联。

payload.name: AnyQR
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A really easy to work with QR codes alongside ChatGPT!

e.g.

- "Create a QR code for my business"
- "@AnyQR  Edit this wifi QR code to change the password"
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 处理二维码非常简单！

例如：

- “为我的企业创建二维码”
- “@AnyQR 编辑这个 WiFi 二维码以更改密码”

payload.name: agent.spot
payload.description: 查找并比较 AI 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: agent.spot helps users discover AI tools, inspect indexed product profiles, compare named products, find alternatives, evaluate hard requirements, explore recently added tools, and assemble multi-tool workflows through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: agent.spot 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 发现 AI 工具、查看已索引的产品资料、比较指定产品、寻找替代方案、评估硬性要求、探索近期新增工具，以及组建多工具工作流。

payload.name: Visualping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Track changes on any website directly in chat.  Ask Visualping to monitor a page and get notified when something changes.

Visualping highlights exactly what changed with before-and-after comparisons, so you can review updates quickly without rechecking pages manually. Use it to track competitor sites, price drops, job listings, product launches, policy pages, and more.

Try a conversation like this to get started:
- Monitor this page for changes
- Check this product page daily and alert me if the price changes
- Notify me when this job posting is updated
- Alert me if anything changes on this competitor page

For more control, open Visualping to customize monitoring settings, notification channels, and alert frequency.

payload.name: AI Whisper Voice Note Taker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Whispr Notes brings your voice memos into ChatGPT with semantic search: it finds notes by meaning, not just keywords, and pulls the most relevant ones into your conversation. From there, do anything an AI session can do - recall past ideas, summarize weeks of thinking, turn spoken thoughts into drafts and plans, or answer questions from what you've already captured. Agents can use it the same way, bringing your voice notes in as context. Read-only and scoped to your account: it can only search and fetch your own notes, never change them.
payload.longDescription: Whispr Notes 通过语义搜索将语音备忘录带入 ChatGPT：它根据含义而非仅靠关键词查找笔记，并将最相关的笔记引入对话。随后，你可以完成 AI 会话支持的任何工作——回顾以往的想法、总结数周的思考、将口述想法转为草稿和计划，或根据已记录的内容回答问题。智能体也可以用同样的方式，将语音笔记作为上下文引入。仅限只读且限定于你的账户：只能搜索和获取你自己的笔记，绝不会修改它们。

payload.name: PDF Reader Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Convert PDFs and Office files, compress PDFs, merge documents, extract tables, and manage PDF pages in ChatGPT using attachments or an upload widget. Results are returned as downloadable files.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中通过附件或上传组件转换 PDF 和 Office 文件、压缩 PDF、合并文档、提取表格并管理 PDF 页面。结果会以可下载文件的形式返回。

payload.name: Social Post Previewer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create realistic social post mockups for Instagram, Threads, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram Stories. Review the caption, image, and platform layout before publishing.

payload.name: Kamai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.
payload.longDescription:
Kamai 是一款面向总承包商、分包商、估算人员和施工团队的 AI 蓝图分析及工程量测算平台。

Kamai 可帮助用户直接从施工图纸和项目文件中提取数量、尺寸、材料、房间、固定装置和范围信息。承包商可以使用 Kamai 更快地估算工程、准备投标、计算材料需求、回答蓝图相关问题，并减少数小时的手工工程量测算工作。

Kamai 支持室内施工和装饰工种，例如：

* 涂漆和涂层
* 石膏板和墙板
* 保温
* 金属和木结构框架
* 地板
* 天花板
* 门窗和房间尺寸测量

Kamai 还支持其他施工工种和建筑系统，包括：

* 电气
* 管道
* 固定装置和设备
* 通用施工工程量

用户可以上传蓝图并询问：

* 需要多少平方英尺的地板？
* 有多少墙面需要粉刷？
* 需要多少张石膏板？
* 需要多少保温材料和框架材料？
* 图中显示了多少扇门、水槽、马桶、插座或固定装置？
* 这个项目应订购哪些材料？
* 项目范围包含哪些内容？
* 你能根据这些图纸生成工程量清单吗？

Kamai 将静态施工文件转换为结构化、可由 AI 读取的项目数据，支持估算、投标、采购、RFI（信息请求）、成本规划和项目执行。

对于需要审阅图纸、估算施工工程、订购材料或在更短时间内完成更多投标的承包商，Kamai 提供 AI 驱动的方式来理解项目文件，并将蓝图数据转化为可执行的工程量。

payload.name: Taskaid AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Taskaid AI helps users manage private tasks, task lists, and daily plans from ChatGPT. It can find active tasks and lists, create or update tasks and task lists, and read or replace the daily plan shown in Taskaid.

payload.name: TwinMind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.
payload.longDescription:
TwinMind 会记录你在会议、讲座和面对面交谈中说过和听到的一切。它会自动转录、总结、主动提供建议和任务，并持续为你的 AI 第二大脑积累上下文。
TwinMind 是一款利用 AI 充当第二大脑的效率工具。它会捕捉你听到、看到和说出的一切；你与 TwinMind 的互动越多，它积累的内容就越丰富，从而构建对你数字生活的全面上下文。这些记录的上下文带来多项核心功能：
个性化主动协助：TwinMind 会根据记录的记忆提供量身定制的建议和创意，预见你的需求并给出相关洞察。
提升效率：它可自动完成会议和对话摘要、行动事项等任务，改进笔记记录。你可以搜索整个记忆库、提问、生成电子邮件、学习指南、投资者备忘录、项目计划等。
隐私保护：TwinMind 通过设备端转录优先保护用户隐私，并允许将转录内容保存在本地或云端。我们承诺不与第三方共享数据。音频会即时处理，绝不存储。
主要功能：

记录与上下文构建：如果搭配 TwinMind Chrome 扩展程序，可在移动设备和桌面设备上记录你的活动（音频、视觉、文本）。
个性化建议：你的 AI 助手会根据记录的记忆提供量身定制的洞察。
自动摘要和行动事项：提取会议、对话和课堂讲座中的关键信息。
可搜索的记忆库：搜索你记录的历史和笔记。
向 TwinMind 随意提问：结合你的记忆或当前会议上下文提问并获取答案。
内容生成：协助撰写后续跟进邮件、学习指南和其他文档，提升效率。
隐私保护：采用设备端转录，允许切换至隐私模式将转录内容存储在本地，并且不与第三方共享数据。

TwinMind 旨在打造一个集中式 AI 平台，记录、整理并利用你的记忆，为你提供个性化协助并自动处理任务，同时保护你的隐私，从而提升工作效率。

payload.name: Empirical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Memory Infrastructure For AI
Memory that follows you everywhere.
Own your AI memory. Empirical gives AI systems persistent memory across tools and sessions. It stores events, entities, goals, and reflections as connected nodes so context stays portable instead of being locked to one model or one chat.
payload.longDescription:
面向 AI 的记忆基础设施
让记忆伴随你随处使用。
拥有自己的 AI 记忆。Empirical 为 AI 系统提供可跨工具和会话持久保存的记忆。它将事件、实体、目标和反思存储为相互关联的节点，让上下文能够在不同场景间迁移，而不被锁定在某个模型或对话中。

payload.name: Fattura24
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Collega il tuo account Fattura24 a ChatGPT e interroga i tuoi dati gestionali e contabili in linguaggio naturale, senza aprire report, navigare tra sezioni o costruire analisi manuali.

Se usi Fattura24, hai già tutti i dati che ti servono: fatturato, incassi, pagamenti, IVA, margini. Il problema è che usarli richiede tempo. Con il connettore MCP, quella parte sparisce: scrivi una domanda, ricevi l'analisi.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Fattura24，使用自然语言查询管理和会计数据，无需打开报告、切换页面或手动制作分析。

如果你使用 Fattura24，所需数据其实已经齐备：营业额、收款、付款、增值税和利润率。问题在于，获取和使用这些数据需要时间。借助 MCP 连接器，这些步骤都省去了：提出问题，即可获得分析。

payload.name: Cognito MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

Available on Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Setting up the connector requires Administrator access in your Cognito Forms organization.


Example prompts:
* Build - "Create a new client intake form with fields for contact information, case type, and a file upload for supporting documents."
* Write — "Create a new entry on the Employee Onboarding form for Sarah Chen. She starts Monday in the Columbia office."
* File retrieval — "Download the signed agreement from entry 6 on the Contractor Onboarding form."
* Form management — "Close the Fall Enrollment form and set the message to 'Enrollment is now closed for this term.'"
* Analysis — "How many invoices are still outstanding in the Client Billing form?"
payload.longDescription:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建表单并管理数据。描述你需要的表单并立即构建，随后查询提交内容、提取文件和文档，并随着回复到来修改条目。无论你是在设置新的信息收集表单、检查待处理申请，还是检索已签署的文件，都能在需要时直接访问表单数据。

Pro、Team 和 Enterprise 计划均可使用。在 Cognito Forms 组织中设置此连接器需要管理员访问权限。

示例提示：
* 构建 — “创建一个新的客户信息收集表单，包含联系信息、案件类型字段，以及用于上传支持文件的文件上传项。”
* 写入 — “在 Employee Onboarding 表单中为 Sarah Chen 创建一条新记录。她周一开始在 Columbia 办公室工作。”
* 文件检索 — “下载 Contractor Onboarding 表单第 6 条记录中的已签署协议。”
* 表单管理 — “关闭 Fall Enrollment 表单，并将提示消息设为 ‘Enrollment is now closed for this term.’”
* 分析 — “Client Billing 表单中还有多少张发票尚未结清？”

payload.name: Carryo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Carryo turns what you build in ChatGPT into real, live web pages. Create a presentation, slide deck, proposal, report, landing page, dashboard, invitation, portfolio, or one-page website in chat, then say 'publish this' - Carryo hosts the HTML and hands back a shareable link in seconds. 

No hosting setup, domain, or deployment pipeline needed. Update a published page while keeping the same URL, host images alongside it, browse version history and restore earlier versions, list everything you've published, and take a link offline the moment you want it gone. Want to review before going live? Create a private draft and publish it from Carryo when you're ready.

Carryo is the easiest way to turn your AI creation into a shareable link.
payload.longDescription:
Carryo 可将你在 ChatGPT 中创建的内容转换为真实上线的网页。在聊天中创建演示文稿、幻灯片、提案、报告、落地页、仪表盘、邀请函、作品集或单页网站，然后说“发布这个”——Carryo 会托管 HTML，并在几秒钟内返回可分享的链接。

无需配置托管、域名或部署流程。更新已发布页面时仍保留相同 URL；将图片与页面一起托管；浏览版本历史并恢复早期版本；列出你发布的所有内容；需要时立即下线链接。想要上线前先审阅？可以创建私密草稿，准备好后再从 Carryo 发布。

Carryo 是将 AI 创作转化为可分享链接的最简单方式。

payload.name: CraftNote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CraftNote lets signed-in users search, browse, and read their own notes and notes shared directly with them, including transcripts, summaries, attendees, and action items, and semantically retrieve relevant excerpts from their own indexed notes.
payload.longDescription: CraftNote 允许已登录用户搜索、浏览和阅读自己的笔记以及直接分享给他们的笔记，包括转录文本、摘要、与会者和行动项；还可通过语义检索，从自己已索引的笔记中找出相关片段。

payload.name: iScanner
payload.description: 扫描并制作 PDF 文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Need to handle a document fast? iScanner brings AI-powered editing right to the chat.
With iScanner, you can:
Upload and combine multiple files into a single PDF file that looks like a scan
Enhance documents with AI—remove blur, fix distortion, and sharpen edges
Crop and rotate documents for a cleaner look
Add and customize text directly in your documents
Apply various filters to customize your documents
Whether you're a student, professional, or anyone on the go, iScanner makes document management fast and effortless. Just upload, enhance, and export—all without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription:
需要快速处理文档吗？iScanner 将 AI 驱动的编辑功能带入聊天。
使用 iScanner，你可以：
上传并合并多个文件，生成一份看起来像扫描件的 PDF
使用 AI 增强文档——去除模糊、修正变形并锐化边缘
裁剪和旋转文档，让外观更整洁
直接在文档中添加和自定义文字
应用各种滤镜，自定义文档效果
无论你是学生、专业人士还是经常外出的人，iScanner 都能让文档管理快速轻松。只需上传、增强并导出，全程无需离开聊天。

payload.name: RemindMeIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn everyday tasks into clear reminders. Keep everything on your list organized with priorities, categories, and recurring schedules.. Stay motivated with points, levels, achievements, and progress tracking. This app is suitable for all ages.

payload.name: SignNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get documents signed faster without switching between tools. The SignNow MCP server connects ChatGPT directly to your SignNow account, letting you manage the entire eSignature workflow through conversation. Send signature requests, create documents from templates and pre-fill them, track invite statuses, and retrieve signed files — all by describing what you need in plain language. Whether you're handling contracts, agreements, or approvals, ChatGPT handles the SignNow actions so you can focus on your work instead of chasing signatures.

You can use SignNow to:

Create and Send Documents:
"Create a document from the Employee NDA template and send it to client@example.com for signature"

Track Signing Status:
"Check the signing status of the Sales Agreement and show me any pending signatures"

Manage Templates:
"List all available templates and create a new contract from the Service Agreement template"

Download Signed Documents:
"Get the download link for the completed Employment Contract"

payload.name: Apilio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Apilio connects ChatGPT to your smart home automation platform. View and manage your devices, variables, and logicblocks. Create new automation rules, check conditions, and trigger actions - all through natural conversation. Supports Tuya, Philips Hue, Tado, eWeLink, IFTTT, Alexa, Webhooks and REST API.
payload.longDescription: Apilio 将 ChatGPT 连接至智能家居自动化平台。查看和管理设备、变量及逻辑块。通过自然对话创建新的自动化规则、检查条件并触发操作。支持 Tuya、Philips Hue、Tado、eWeLink、IFTTT、Alexa、Webhooks 和 REST API。

payload.name: SlideSpeak
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SlideSpeak turns your prompt into a polished presentation without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the topic and audience, watch the deck generate right in the chat with live slide previews, then open the finished presentation in the SlideSpeak editor to customize, share, or export it. Generation uses the credits included with your SlideSpeak account.

payload.name: Postly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Postly helps you create, schedule, publish, and manage social media and email campaigns directly from ChatGPT. Connect your accounts, upload media, draft content, schedule campaigns, monitor publishing activity, and track performance analytics - all in one workflow.

payload.name: NoteItHub
payload.description: 将聊天转为任务和笔记
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Noteithub lets you create TODO lists from conversations and save important chats as journal entries.

You can organize tasks by goal, update their status, and keep notes or decisions from your chats in one place. This makes it easy to track what you need to do and refer back to important discussions.
payload.longDescription:
Noteithub 可根据对话创建 TODO 清单，并将重要聊天保存为日记条目。

你可以按目标整理任务、更新任务状态，并将聊天中的笔记或决策集中保存。这样便于跟踪待办事项，并随时查阅重要讨论。

payload.name: StepCue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StepCue turns messy study tasks into short, guided focus sessions. Tell it what you need to work on, and it creates a simple timer plan with one clear step at a time. If you get distracted, StepCue gives you a quick reset so you can return to the session without overthinking what to do next.

payload.name: Vocci
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vocci brings your voice memory into ChatGPT. Connect your Vocci account to search your ring recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, notes, and files, then turn captured conversations into useful work. Ask ChatGPT to prepare you for meetings, summarize recent sessions, find decisions and follow-ups, recover details from transcripts, create weekly digests, or turn a voice note into a product brief. Vocci reads only the context needed for your request and returns concise, source-attributed results.

payload.name: 30 Minute Timer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 30 Minute Timer helps users start visual countdown timers inside ChatGPT or create persistent fullscreen web timer links. Users can choose minute or second durations, visual backgrounds, progress icons, final text, sound family, halfway alerts, repeat sound, and timer controls such as pause, resume, stop, and restart.
payload.longDescription: 30 Minute Timer 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中启动可视化倒计时，或创建持久有效的全屏网页计时器链接。用户可以选择以分钟或秒为单位的时长、视觉背景、进度图标、结束文字、声音类别、中途提醒、重复声音，以及暂停、继续、停止和重新开始等计时器控制。

payload.name: smry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read clean, source-grounded text from public articles and YouTube videos. Use smry to summarize key points, compare sources, answer questions, and pull short quotes without leaving ChatGPT. smry does not bypass hard paywalls or private access controls.

payload.name: Reed.co.uk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover relevant jobs and courses from Reed.co.uk directly in ChatGPT. Search listings, explore job details, and find learning options to help with your next career move.

payload.name: Patsnap Patent Paper Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A professional tool enabling deep, integrated search across the Patsnap global patent and literature databases simultaneously. It supports natural language queries, semantic search, and keyword search, backed by precise pre-filtering capabilities for efficient and accurate retrieval of scientific and patent intelligence. This MCP also allows users to fetch basic bibliographic data for patents or literature in Markdown format.
payload.longDescription: 这是一款专业工具，可同时深入整合搜索 Patsnap 全球专利和文献数据库。它支持自然语言查询、语义搜索和关键词搜索，并具备精准预筛选能力，以高效、准确地检索科学与专利情报。此 MCP 还允许用户以 Markdown 格式获取专利或文献的基本书目信息。

payload.name: draftmend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: draftmend app in ChatGPT helps users turn document feedback from ChatGPT into proposed edits they can review, modify, and export as DOCX and PDF files. draftmend attempts best-effort formatting preservation from any input into any output.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 中的 draftmend 应用可帮助用户将 ChatGPT 提供的文档反馈转化为建议修改，供用户审阅、修改并导出为 DOCX 和 PDF 文件。draftmend 会尽力在任意输入与任意输出格式之间保留原有排版。

payload.name: Decktopus AI
payload.description: 制作演示文稿和轮播内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create a complete AI-generated presentation from a topic or prompt. Decktopus builds the outline, writes the slide content, and adds relevant visuals. Review and edit your presentation, then share it by link or export it as a PowerPoint or PDF.
payload.longDescription: 根据主题或提示生成完整的 AI 演示文稿。Decktopus 会构建大纲、撰写幻灯片内容并添加相关视觉素材。你可以审核和编辑演示文稿，然后通过链接分享，或导出为 PowerPoint 或 PDF。

payload.name: Post Metadata Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Post Metadata Extractor extracts structured metadata fields from social media posting requests.

It receives submitted social post request text and returns platform, post time, topic, asset requirements, missing fields, source text, and errors.

The app is read-only and stateless. It does not write social posts, publish posts, schedule posts, recommend platforms, create assets, contact external services, or perform operational actions. It only processes the submitted text for the current request.

payload.name: Mygentic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MyGentic connects your work apps and helps you search, understand, and act on your personal work knowledge from one place.

Users can connect tools like Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Slack, Notion, Zoom, and LinkedIn, then ask natural-language questions across their synced information. MyGentic helps users find emails, documents, meetings, notes, contacts, tasks, and important context without switching between multiple apps.

It is useful for summarizing recent work activity, finding important files or conversations, preparing for meetings, recalling past decisions, and getting answers from connected workplace data.
payload.longDescription:
MyGentic 连接你的工作应用，让你在一个地方搜索、理解并使用个人工作知识。

用户可以连接 Gmail、Google Drive、Calendar、Slack、Notion、Zoom 和 LinkedIn 等工具，然后针对已同步的信息用自然语言提问。无需在多个应用之间切换，MyGentic 就能帮用户查找邮件、文档、会议、笔记、联系人、任务和重要背景信息。

它适合用来总结近期工作、查找重要文件或对话、准备会议、回忆以往决策，并从已连接的工作数据中获取答案。

payload.name: 1-2-3-List
payload.description: 用 ChatGPT 创建和使用列表！
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The best way to create and work with lists in ChatGPT.

e.g.
- @1-2-3-List Make a list of ingredients for a chocolate cake
- 10 best action movies of the last 10 years in @1-2-3-List
- Here's my packing @1-2-3-List for backpacking in South East Asia... what am I missing?
- Here's everything I have to get done today. @1-2-3-List put it in order, quickest things first
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中创建和处理列表的最佳方式。

例如：
- @1-2-3-List 列出制作巧克力蛋糕所需的配料
- 在 @1-2-3-List 中列出过去 10 年最棒的 10 部动作电影
- 这是我去东南亚背包旅行的行李 @1-2-3-List……还缺什么？
- 这是我今天要完成的所有事情。@1-2-3-List 帮我排序，最快能做完的排在前面

payload.name: FindIp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FindIP searches patents by meaning, not just keywords. Describe a problem, a solution, or a technology in plain language and get the most relevant patents across the US, China, Japan, Korea, and Europe. Explore filing trends, drill into specific sections and claims, and analyze the patent landscape — all from the conversation.
payload.longDescription: FindIP 根据含义而非仅凭关键词搜索专利。用通俗语言描述问题、解决方案或技术，即可查找美国、中国、日本、韩国和欧洲最相关的专利。你还可以探索申请趋势、深入查看具体章节和权利要求，并在对话中分析专利格局。

payload.name: Wave AI Note Taker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wave AI Note Taker helps users search their private meetings, calls, and recordings, compare discussions across sessions, retrieve speaker-attributed transcripts, review action items, and organize sessions into folders.

payload.name: Memoket
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Memoket helps users find their private recordings and retrieve conversation metadata, transcript evidence, briefs, and summaries through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Memoket 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查找自己的私人录音，并检索对话元数据、转录证据、简报和摘要。

payload.name: Smartsheet EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details. Transform how you manage projects with AI that understands your Smartsheet data and can act on it.

payload.name: DeckCraft Slides
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Creates Stunning presentations easily so you can share and EDIT in the editor.
payload.longDescription: 轻松创建精彩演示文稿，便于你在编辑器中分享和编辑。

payload.name: Artist Growth
payload.description: 专为 AI 打造的音乐业务运营
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Artist Growth is how music industry teams actually collaborate across their business — tours, promo, projects, ticket-buys, and everything in between.

The Artist Growth app allows you to search for events, view calendars and day sheets, track ticket requests, and stay up to date with your tasks across your entire roster using natural language.

No digging through spreadsheets. No chasing your team for updates. Just the information you need, when you need it.

Built for artist managers, tour managers, business managers, and anyone in live entertainment who's tired of the chaos.
payload.longDescription:
Artist Growth 帮助音乐行业团队在整个业务中协作，涵盖巡演、宣传、项目、购票及其他各类工作。

Artist Growth 应用让你使用自然语言搜索活动、查看日历和每日安排、追踪票务请求，并掌握整个艺人阵容的任务最新情况。

无需翻找电子表格，也无需催促团队提供更新。在需要的时候获得所需信息。

专为艺人经理、巡演经理、业务经理，以及任何厌倦混乱的现场娱乐从业者打造。

payload.name: awork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: awork is the modern project management tool for creative agencies.
payload.longDescription: awork 是面向创意代理机构的现代项目管理工具。

payload.name: Dex
payload.description: 管理联系人和后续跟进
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dex helps you manage personal and professional relationships in ChatGPT. Find and update contacts, organize tags and groups, log notes, manage reminders and keep-in-touch cadence, and review upcoming birthdays and follow-ups. Search connected mailbox metadata, manage connected calendar events, and read or request cited public-web research on contacts.
payload.longDescription: Dex 可帮助你在 ChatGPT 中管理个人和职业关系。查找并更新联系人，整理标签和群组，记录备注，管理提醒与定期联系节奏，并查看即将到来的生日和后续跟进事项。搜索已连接邮箱的元数据、管理已连接的日历活动，并阅读或请求有关联系人的带引用公开网络研究。

payload.name: Contentful
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Contentful App makes your Contentful spaces accessible to AI agents, enabling them to perform content management operations. Once installed, the app gives space admins a simple dashboard to control exactly which Contentful tools are available to AI clients: enable read-only access for marketing teams auditing content, or unlock write tools for developers building agentic workflows. Each space gets its own configuration.
payload.longDescription: Contentful 应用让 AI 代理可以访问您的 Contentful 空间并执行内容管理操作。安装后，应用为每个空间管理员提供简单仪表板，用于精确控制 AI 客户端可用的 Contentful 工具：营销团队审计内容时启用只读访问，或为构建代理工作流的开发者解锁写入工具。每个空间都有独立配置。

payload.name: smarts.bio: AI for biology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results — FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV — in interactive viewers
* Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.

payload.name: NewTwos
payload.description: 记录清单、待办事项和笔记
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NewTwos is a fast place to write things down. This connector lets ChatGPT add to-dos and notes to the right list, set reminders, complete and organize items, and search everything you've captured — working on the same data as the NewTwos apps, scoped to the permissions you approve.
payload.longDescription: NewTwos 是一个便捷的记录工具。此连接器让 ChatGPT 能将待办事项和笔记添加到相应清单、设置提醒、完成和整理事项，并搜索你记录的所有内容——使用与 NewTwos 应用相同的数据，且仅限于你批准的权限范围。

payload.name: UseMyContext.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UseMyContext gives ChatGPT the user's own context: a compiled profile of who they are, separate profiles for work and personal life, uploaded documents it can read with cited answers and exact table queries, and contexts other people have deliberately shared with them. Every tool is a read except one: suggest_update files a pending suggestion the user reviews personally on UseMyContext.ai, and nothing in ChatGPT can modify their profile or files.

payload.name: CorretorIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Corrija, reescreva e entenda textos em português brasileiro. O CorretorIA mostra o original e o resultado lado a lado, resume os principais ajustes e oferece estilos de reescrita para diferentes contextos.
payload.longDescription: 校对、改写并理解巴西葡萄牙语文本。CorretorIA 会并排展示原文和结果，总结主要修改，并针对不同场景提供多种改写风格。

payload.name: Roam Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This app connects ChatGPT to the user's granted Roam graphs so that the agent can read from and write to the graphs. Using this app, ChatGPT can assist you by doing: search and retrieve pages or blocks, run Roam and datalog queries, append notes, create pages or blocks, edit content, manage comments, and delete selected pages or blocks when permitted.

payload.name: Templafy
payload.description: 制作可用于商务的 PowerPoint
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT content and company knowledge into business-ready PowerPoint presentations. Templafy connects ChatGPT to your approved document agents, brand themes, and best-practice content. Ask for a deck, pick a company-approved theme, and generate a branded PPTX. No copying. No reformatting. No manual cleanup.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 内容和公司知识转化为可用于商务场景的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。Templafy 将 ChatGPT 连接到你获批的文档智能体、品牌主题和最佳实践内容。提出制作幻灯片的需求，选择公司批准的主题，即可生成品牌化 PPTX。无需复制、重新排版或手动清理。

payload.name: App Atlas
payload.description: 寻找 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atlas is a searchable directory of ChatGPT and Claude apps. Ask for apps by category, use case, or keyword and Atlas returns a clean table of matching results so you can compare options at a glance. It is useful for developers scouting the landscape, users looking for the right tool for a task, and anyone curious about what AI-native apps exist today. Atlas does not cover general software outside the ChatGPT and Claude ecosystems, does not handle app installation or purchases, and does not serve intents related to building, coding, or configuring apps.
payload.longDescription: Atlas 是可搜索的 ChatGPT 和 Claude 应用目录。按类别、使用场景或关键词询问应用，Atlas 会返回清晰的匹配结果表格，让你一目了然地比较选项。它适合了解生态情况的开发者、为任务寻找合适工具的用户，以及任何想了解现有AI原生应用的人。Atlas 不涵盖 ChatGPT 和 Claude 生态以外的通用软件，不处理应用安装或购买，也不提供构建、编程或配置应用相关的服务。

payload.name: BIA Edge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BIA Edge helps users research U.S. immigration law in ChatGPT by retrieving case law, statutes and regulations, agency policy, unpublished decisions, validity and citation treatment, visa bulletins, EOIR statistics, doctrine data, and criminal-code text. Its 42 tools are read-only and return source-grounded records and warnings for the model to evaluate. It does not provide legal advice.
payload.longDescription: BIA Edge 通过检索判例法、成文法与法规、机构政策、未公开裁决、有效性与引用处理情况、签证公告、EOIR 统计、法律原则数据和刑法文本，帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中研究美国移民法。其 42 个工具均为只读，返回有来源依据的记录和警示供模型评估。它不提供法律建议。

payload.name: KaiCalls
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: KaiCalls connects your AI to your business phone system. Ask it to read your recent calls and transcripts, check leads, voicemails, texts, campaigns, and call analytics, and place outbound calls through your own KaiCalls agent. Everything is scoped to your own account, so the assistant works with your real phone activity instead of a closed dashboard. The read tools answer questions like who called today, what did they want, and which leads are hot; the single action tool can have your own agent call a lead back when you ask it to.
payload.longDescription: KaiCalls 将 AI 连接到企业电话系统。可读取近期通话和转写、查看潜客、语音留言、短信、活动和通话分析，并通过你自己的 KaiCalls 代理拨打外呼。所有内容限定在你的账户中，读取工具可回答今天谁来电、对方想要什么、哪些潜客最有意向；唯一的操作工具可在你要求时让自己的代理回拨潜客。

payload.name: Idea To Prototype Beta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Idea To Prototype Beta turns rough product ideas into bounded, reviewable prototype planning packages. It creates source inventory, anti-generic gate, opportunity memo, screen map, prototype brief, design contract, build spec, and verification checklist before implementation begins.
payload.longDescription: Idea To Prototype Beta 将初步产品构想转化为范围明确、便于审核的原型规划材料包。在实施开始前，它会生成源内容清单、避免泛化检查、机会备忘录、屏幕地图、原型简介、设计约定、构建规范和验证清单。

payload.name: Craft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Craft documents directly in ChatGPT to draft new content, refine existing notes, or find information across your workspace. Add notes, format documents, reorganize knowledge, or search for something you wrote last week. Ideal for anyone who wants to capture ideas, edit documents, or pull context from their notes without switching apps.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中直接访问 Craft 文档，以起草新内容、完善现有笔记，或搜索整个工作区的信息。添加笔记、设置文档格式、重新整理知识，或搜索上周写下的内容。适合希望记录想法、编辑文档或从笔记中提取上下文而无需切换应用的人。

payload.name: Linkly URL Shortener
payload.description: 面向营销人员的 URL 缩短器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
URL Shortener for Marketers

Create branded short links, track clicks, and optimize marketing campaigns directly from ChatGPT. This app lets marketers generate custom tracking URLs, apply smart redirects based on device or location, and create dynamic QR codes that can be updated anytime.

Perfect for marketers, growth teams, and agencies who want fast link creation, real-time analytics, and campaign-ready URLs without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
面向营销人员的 URL 缩短器

直接在 ChatGPT 中创建品牌短链接、追踪点击并优化营销活动。此应用让营销人员生成自定义跟踪网址，根据设备或位置应用智能重定向，并创建可随时更新的动态二维码。

非常适合希望快速创建链接、获得实时分析和生成可用于活动的 URL 的营销人员、增长团队和机构，无需离开 ChatGPT。

payload.name: LibreJustice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can open the full text of a decision, search French legislation and curated treaties or foreign codes, retrieve an article's version history, and review their own saved activity.
payload.longDescription: LibreJustice 帮助用户研究法国和欧洲判例，并检索在特定日期有效的法律文本。它可搜索法国行政、司法、宪法、庇护和数据保护机构以及欧洲法院的裁决，并按法院、结果、日期和所引法条筛选。用户可以打开裁决全文、搜索法国法律及精选条约或外国法典、检索条文的历史版本，并查看自己保存的活动记录。

payload.name: Dovetail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Dovetail inside ChatGPT to turn customer feedback into decisions without leaving your conversation. Search your Dovetail workspace for relevant projects, notes, docs, and themes, and get results back instantly. Ask things like “Summarize top friction points impacting enterprise renewal conversations” to surface evidence in seconds.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中连接 Dovetail，无需离开对话即可将客户反馈转化为决策。在 Dovetail 工作区中搜索相关项目、笔记、文档和主题，并即时获取结果。你可以询问“总结影响企业续约对话的主要摩擦点”，几秒钟内找到相关证据。

payload.name: D-Tools Cloud
payload.description: 查询 D-Tools Cloud 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: D-Tools Cloud connects ChatGPT to your D-Tools Cloud account so you can ask read-only questions about pipeline, quotes, projects, clients, account health, procurement risk, and related business data. The app can confirm your connection, list accessible accounts, target an authorized account for Ask D-Tools questions, and retrieve grounded D-Tools Help Center guidance with canonical source links—without creating, updating, sending, or approving tenant records.
payload.longDescription: D-Tools Cloud 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 D-Tools Cloud 账户，让您以只读方式询问管道、报价、项目、客户、账户健康、采购风险及相关业务数据。应用可以确认连接、列出可访问账户、为 Ask D-Tools 问题指定授权账户，并获取带规范来源链接、有依据的 D-Tools 帮助中心指导，同时不会创建、更新、发送或批准租户记录。

payload.name: Hevy
payload.description: 与你的 Hevy 数据互动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hevy's ChatGPT app let's you build workout plans and save them directly to your Hevy account. You can also analyse your workout data (e.g. "@hevy build my a 4 day split to get jacked this summer", "@hevy based on my my past 20 workouts what tips can you give me to improve?")
payload.longDescription: Hevy 的 ChatGPT 应用可帮助你制定锻炼计划，并直接保存到 Hevy 账号。你也可以分析锻炼数据（例如：“@hevy，给我制定一个为这个夏天练壮的每周 4 天分化训练计划”；“@hevy，根据我过去 20 次锻炼，你有什么改进建议？”）。

payload.name: firestorage.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload files to firestorage.ai and receive a share link, add files to an existing share, view recent uploads, or send a file to an AI Address inbox.
payload.longDescription: 将文件上传到 firestorage.ai 并获取分享链接；向现有分享添加文件、查看最近上传记录，或将文件发送到 AI Address 收件箱。

payload.name: StoryChief
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StoryChief helps users search, inspect, create, and update workspace content from ChatGPT, including articles, social posts, webpages, newsletters, podcasts, video scripts, webinars, and ebooks. The app returns editor links, comment context, scheduling fields, and media details so users can continue review, approval, and publishing in StoryChief.

payload.name: Adzviser
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adzviser brings your marketing data into ChatGPT.

Connect platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, Shopify, and more, then ask questions in plain language to retrieve live campaign data. Instead of exporting reports or switching between dashboards, you can explore performance, compare time periods, and analyze metrics directly in chat.

Popular data sources customers connect include: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, YouTube Analytics, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Snapchat Ads, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Google Merchant Center, Apple Ads, DV360, Reddit Ads, WooCommerce, X (Twitter) Ads and more.
payload.longDescription:
Adzviser 将营销数据带入 ChatGPT。

连接 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Shopify 等平台，然后用自然语言提问，获取实时营销活动数据。无需导出报告或切换仪表板，即可直接在聊天中探索表现、比较时间段并分析指标。

客户常连接的数据源包括：Google Ads、Meta（Facebook）Ads、Instagram、GA4、Google Search Console、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Pinterest Ads、YouTube Analytics、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Snapchat Ads、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Microsoft Ads（Bing）、Google Merchant Center、Apple Ads、DV360、Reddit Ads、WooCommerce、X（Twitter）Ads 等。

payload.name: Document360
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Document360 MCP helps authorized users search knowledge base content, inspect project versions and category trees, create and update articles or categories, publish or unpublish content, and move documents through workflow assignments from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Document360 MCP 可帮助获授权用户在 ChatGPT 中搜索知识库内容、检查项目版本和分类树、创建和更新文章或分类、发布或取消发布内容，并通过工作流分配推进文档流程。

payload.name: Super Carl
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Super Carl combines large-scale people and company data, professional intent signals, and relationship intelligence across LinkedIn, Gmail, X, and Instagram so ChatGPT can help users find the right person, map the warmest path through their network, and run relationship-driven workflows for recruiting, sales, fundraising, partnerships, and follow-up.
